title: Fourier coefficient bound from distance
statement: Let $f,g:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ be Boolean-valued functions, let $S\subseteq[n]$, and let $\varepsilon\in\bbr$. Write $f^{\pm},g^{\pm}:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ for their $\pm1$ lifts, given by $x\mapsto(-1)^{f(x)}$ and $x\mapsto(-1)^{g(x)}$. Suppose that $g^{\pm}$ coincides with the Walsh character $\chi_S$, and that $\dist(f,g)=\Pr_{x}[f(x)\ne g(x)]\ge\varepsilon$. Then the Fourier coefficient of $f^{\pm}$ at $S$ satisfies \[\widehat{f^{\pm}}(S)\;\le\;1-2\varepsilon.\]
hypotheses_covered: f, g are Boolean-valued functions on {0,1}^n
the ±1 lift of g equals the Walsh character χ_S
